prerequisite: complete digest-bound five-benchmark P3 natural-suite audit; P4 baselines run even if the adaptive causal arm is withheld
optional_context_gate: not in this reference matrix; support must be established by a separate preflight after 131072 tokens
matrix_interpretation: batch and serial round-robin active-request sweeps are separate reference profiles. The active-request profiles are not simultaneous serving concurrency and do not satisfy the production concurrency gate.
production_concurrency_requirement: A later fused or serving-runtime matrix must independently measure actual concurrency 1/8/32 with request overlap and scheduler timestamps.
paired_policy_order: alternate resident-first and tiered-first by repetition
measurements: CUDA allocated/reserved/peak bytes and allocator fragmentation
logical/hot/cold cache bytes and pinned host bytes
prefetches, evictions, late misses, useful-transfer ratio
native indexer time from a separate untimed one-token trace
greedy prediction digest equality under identical teacher-forced tokens
OOM, timeout, numerical failure, and unexpected exception records

execution.policy_failure_isolated: if either resident or tiered fails, continue all 30 measured repetitions for the surviving policy and report the cell as partial

claim_boundary: Serial-interleaved reference PyTorch evidence only. It is not actual concurrent serving, a fused-kernel, multi-GPU, or production-throughput claim.
